subject: Live demo slot hold — alignment on access, sample data & exec travel
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Live demo slot hold — alignment on access, sample data & exec travel

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for the interest and for locking in time for the live demo. A quick ask before we commit the final agenda: can we add 48 hours of buffer before the customer-facing session for our team to validate prompt sets and ingest a small slice of your sample traces?

Two constraints on our side: Markus (our lead engineer) is traveling the week of Apr 5 and the execs indicated they might join, so we want to avoid any last-minute access gating during the demo. If possible, could your security/admin team provision read-only sample access or drop a one-off sample (<=1000 rows) into the Drive link below by EOD Apr 4? That will let us run a quick workload trace and confirm the demo flows.

Proposed approach:
- Hold Apr 7 10:00–11:00 PT as the tentative live demo slot (we can move if that collides with your execs)
- Internal dry run for us on Apr 5 — 60–90 minutes to validate prompts, traces, and any role-based access
- Deliverables from Finlytics: a small sample dataset + a user with demo-view access, or a dumped CSV + schema

I’m copying Marissa and Priyom to coordinate the dry run and runbook. If Apr 7 doesn't work for your execs, say what does and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0133
[Attachment: redwood-demo-access-checklist.pdf (pdf)]
[Drive: https://drive.google.com/finlytics/sample-data-2027]
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@finlytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finlytics Procurement <procure@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live demo slot hold — alignment on access, sample data & exec travel

Jonas —

Appreciate the heads-up. Exec travel just shifted: our CTO will be out Apr 6–8 and we were hoping they'd join. The product team can still run the session but we'd prefer to reschedule the customer-facing demo to the following week so the CTO can attend.

We can provide a redacted sample dataset by Apr 4 as you requested — I'll ask IT to drop a 500-row CSV into the Drive link and grant a demo-view account. Procurement asked if there will be any short-form paperwork before the demo; I copied them here so they can flag anything early.

Does Apr 14 or Apr 15 look possible on your side for the live demo? If you need an internal dry run before that, Apr 12 afternoon PT works for us.

Best,
Avery Collins
Head of Product, Finlytics
avery.collins@finlytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@finlytics.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live demo slot hold — alignment on access, sample data & exec travel

Thanks Avery — that timeline is workable.

Next steps from our side (I will own coordination):
- We'll schedule a 75-min internal dry run on Apr 12 14:00–15:15 PT. Agenda: run through prompt sets, validate tokenization on the sample traces, sanity-check RBAC flows.
- Can Finlytics IT drop the sample CSV + schema and create one demo-view user (sso or local) with viewer rights by Apr 4? If SSO will take longer, a local account is fine for the dry run.
- Please confirm any IP/data redaction constraints — we will only use the 500-row sample and will not persist PII.

I attached our access checklist and a short sample-data schema template to make it easier to drop things in.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

[Attachment: sample-data-schema.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Avery Collins <avery.collins@finlytics.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live demo slot hold — alignment on access, sample data & exec travel

Perfect — thanks Marissa. I’ll hold Apr 14 and 15 afternoon PT as options for the customer-facing demo and lock the internal dry run on Apr 12. Priyom, can you prepare the runbook bullets (login, prompts to exercise, expected outputs) and drop them into the Drive by EOD Apr 9?

Avery — if procurement needs anything signed to permit the demo-view account, let us know. Otherwise we’ll proceed with a local demo account for the practice.

Jonas
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@finlytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finlytics Procurement <procure@finlytics.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live demo slot hold — alignment on access, sample data & exec travel

Thanks — confirmed. We will:
- Drop a redacted 500-row CSV and the schema in the Drive by EOD Apr 4 (link above)
- Create a demo-view local account for the dry run and email credentials to the Redwood team (secure channel)
- Procurement: no contract signature required for a single dry run/demo-view account; we'll advise if anything else is needed for a live POC.

I'll send a calendar invite for Apr 12 dry run shortly and propose Apr 14 11:00–12:00 PT for the live demo. If that conflicts with anything on your end, flag it and we'll pivot.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the run-through.

—Avery
